activity_title: Bulk selection and delete for Conversations
activity_summary: Added a checkbox column, select-all, a selected-count bar and a bulk Delete action with a confirmation dialog to the admin Conversations table. Deleting a conversation cascades to its messages and citations; knowledge-gap and provider-log references are set NULL so history is preserved. Verified live: 2 sessions deleted, messages and citations went to 0.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 3 Admin Record Management; POST /api/admin/conversations/bulk-delete returns {deleted}; FK cascade chat_sessions->chat_messages->message_citations verified; audit action conversation.deleted; no commit hash (uncommitted working tree)
reusable_pattern: Reusable BulkDeleteButton component driving the DataTable selection API (selectable/selected/onSelectionChange/bulkActions), reused on Conversations and Gaps.
validation_rule: Bulk delete must show a confirmation before removing rows and must preserve DB integrity: dependent rows cascade, referenced history rows are set NULL, ids validated by Zod.
gap_or_risk: Bulk endpoint runs single deletes server-side; large selections are capped at 500 ids by the validator.
next_action: Reuse the same BulkDeleteButton pattern on any future admin list that needs bulk removal.

activity_title: Bulk selection and delete for Knowledge Gaps
activity_summary: Applied the same bulk selection, select-all, count and confirmed bulk Delete to the Knowledge Gaps table, reusing the shared BulkDeleteButton and the DataTable selection API rather than duplicating UI. Backed by a dedicated bulk-delete endpoint and service.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope; POST /api/admin/gaps/bulk-delete returns {deleted}; audit action gap.deleted; gaps.service.deleteMany DELETE ... WHERE id = ANY($1); verified live delete
reusable_pattern: Reuses the BulkDeleteButton + DataTable selection pattern created in D03-A01.
validation_rule: Delete only the selected gap ids after confirmation; ids validated by shared bulkDeleteSchema.

activity_summary: Built a shared DateRangeFilter (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Custom) and wired it into Conversations and Knowledge Gaps so admins can narrow records before selecting or deleting. Added inclusive from/to bounds to the gaps list API (conversations already had them).
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Date Filter; listGapsQuerySchema from/to (YYYY-MM-DD); gaps.service last_asked_at >= from and < to+1day; verified 10 gaps in a 7-day range
reusable_pattern: Controlled DateRangeFilter component: page owns from/to bounds, the control derives the active preset, Custom reveals native date inputs. Reused across both admin list pages.
validation_rule: Date bounds validated as YYYY-MM-DD; 'to' is inclusive of the whole day (compared against next midnight).
next_action: Reuse DateRangeFilter on other admin lists (e.g. Knowledge documents) if date filtering is needed.

activity_summary: Extended the existing Knowledge Gap Review dialog (no new component) so admins can edit the question text and department in addition to status, resolution note and linked document. Backend PATCH and validator were extended to accept question and departmentId; saving validates, updates, refreshes the table and preserves filters and pagination.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Knowledge Gap Edit; PATCH /api/admin/gaps/:id; updateGapSchema gains question + departmentId; verified edit of question/department/status/note persisted
reusable_pattern: Extend the existing Review dialog rather than duplicating a Create dialog for edit.
validation_rule: At least one field must change; question is required and non-empty; department id validated.

activity_summary: The Eye button on the Conversations table did not open the transcript. Root cause: it was the only place wrapping a TanStack Router <Link> inside a shadcn <Button asChild> (a Radix Slot); the Slot prop-merge stopped the Link's navigation from firing. Fixed by rendering a plain <Link> styled as an icon button - the same reliable pattern the Session title link uses - and removing the conflicting full-row onRowClick.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Conversation View Fix; route /admin/conversations/$id registered and GET /api/admin/conversations/:id returns transcript (both verified healthy); the plain Session-title Link worked, proving the destination; asChild+Slot wrapper was the fault
reusable_pattern: Do not wrap a framework router Link in a Radix Slot (Button asChild) for navigation; render the Link directly and style it.
validation_rule: A row action that navigates must use a real Link element, not a Slot-merged one.
gap_or_risk: Full-row onRowClick conflicted with the new selection checkboxes; removed it as part of the fix.
next_action: Audit other pages for Button-asChild-around-Link if any navigation feels dead.

activity_title: Reduce KPI card height on the Conversations page
activity_summary: Trimmed the shared KPI card vertical padding (py-4 to py-3) in the admin primitives so KPI rows take less height while keeping the same width, typography, layout and spacing. Applies consistently to every admin page that uses the KPI card.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope; Kpi component padding changed px-4 py-3 (was p-4); shared across all KPI rows
reusable_pattern: Adjust the shared KPI primitive once so all admin dashboards stay visually consistent.
validation_rule: Height reduction must not change card width, typography or horizontal spacing.
gap_or_risk: Change is global to all KPI rows (intended, for consistency).

activity_summary: Rebuilt the admin Search Playground with a cleaner info banner (fixing a text-overlap glitch), a larger question field with a character counter, a polished controls row, a 'How it works' step flow and feature cards - all from the existing design system. The working hybrid-retrieval query, score bars and match highlighting were preserved.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Search Playground UI; scoped search still returns vector+keyword scores (verified HR-scoped query); no change to /api/admin/knowledge/search
reusable_pattern: Reuse theme tokens and shadcn components for a consistent admin look; keep retrieval logic untouched during UI work.
validation_rule: UI refresh must not change retrieval results, scores or scope.
gap_or_risk: Interaction feel not browser-verified (no headless click-through available).
next_action: Do a manual click-through of the playground to confirm feel.

activity_title: Hide the All Departments option from the user chat
activity_summary: Removed the 'All departments' option from the user-facing chat: the header dropdown was replaced with a department indicator, and the public /api/departments picker now excludes shared/system departments and lists every active department. Global search remains supported in the backend for admin use only.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope; /api/departments hides is_shared=true and lists active departments; verified picker excludes the Shared bucket
reusable_pattern: Hide system/shared departments from end-user pickers while keeping backend global scope for admins.
validation_rule: The Shared/system department must never appear in the user chat picker.
gap_or_risk: 'All departments' hidden from users only (temporary), backend global scope intentionally retained.

activity_summary: Added a friendly welcome greeting on the chat's empty state that introduces the assistant and what it can help with, shown only for a new conversation and cleared on New Chat, so first-time users get an orientation before asking.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Welcome Message; greeting rendered when messages are empty and no picker is active
reusable_pattern: Show onboarding/greeting only on the empty conversation state, not after every message.
validation_rule: Greeting appears only for a new conversation and never repeats mid-conversation.

activity_title: General questions search Shared knowledge only
activity_summary: Added intent routing so that when no department is selected the system decides whether a question is general or department-specific. General questions are answered from Shared company knowledge only (a new shared-only retrieval scope), with no department prompt. The classifier is deterministic (based on a shared-knowledge match) so it adds no extra vector search and cannot be knocked out by a busy LLM provider.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.2/3 Department-Based Chat; POST /api/chat/intent returns general | department_required; retrieve() sharedOnly scope filters cd.is_shared; verified 'working hours' -> general -> shared answer
reusable_pattern: Deterministic intent classification by shared-knowledge retrieval confidence (no extra LLM call, no extra vector search).
validation_rule: A general question searches Shared knowledge only; it must never trigger a per-department search.
gap_or_risk: Classifier quality depends on general policies actually living in the Shared department.
next_action: Keep company-wide policies uploaded to the Shared department so general questions resolve.

activity_title: Prompt users to select a department for department-specific questions
activity_summary: When a question is classified department-specific and no department has been chosen, the chat shows an in-line radio-button picker (excluding the Shared/system department) asking the user to choose. The held question is then answered against the chosen scope. This replaces any silent global search.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.2/3 Department-Based Chat; intent 'department_required' returns the department list; in-chat DepartmentPicker renders radios; verified prompt-then-answer flow
reusable_pattern: Ask the user to disambiguate scope in-line rather than guessing or widening the search.
validation_rule: Department-specific questions must not be answered until a department is chosen; Shared is never offered as a choice.
gap_or_risk: Fail-safe: if the classifier errors, the user is asked for a department (never auto-answered from the wrong scope).

activity_title: Store the selected department for the current conversation
activity_summary: Once a department is chosen it is remembered for the rest of the conversation, so the user is not asked again; subsequent questions automatically use that department plus Shared. A 'Change department' control lets the user switch, and New Chat resets it. Scope rides on each request via a ref so changing it never drops an in-flight stream.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.3 Scope + 4 Department Memory; conversation department state + sendConfigRef; verified second question reuses the department without re-prompting
reusable_pattern: Hold conversation scope in client state and attach it per request via a ref to avoid re-creating the transport.
validation_rule: After a department is selected, do not prompt again until the user changes it or starts a new chat.
gap_or_risk: Conversation memory is client-side per browser session (matches the existing stateless chat design).

activity_title: Search only Selected Department plus Shared - enforce department isolation
activity_summary: Enforced strict department isolation in retrieval: a scoped search covers only the selected department plus any is_shared department, and the previous silent global fallback (which could return another department's content when the selected one had no match) was removed. If nothing is found in scope the answer is 'no information found'. Added an is_shared flag and a seeded Shared department via migration.
evidence_refs: SKILL 2.2/3 Department Isolation + Shared Knowledge; retrieve() OR cd.is_shared is the only cross-department path; message_citations proved USA question about HR pulled only USA+Shared, never HR; migration 0005 adds is_shared and seeds Shared
reusable_pattern: Department isolation = selected department OR is_shared only; never a global fallback on a low/empty match.
validation_rule: A scoped question must only ever surface the selected department or Shared; return 'no information found' otherwise.
gap_or_risk: Removed the pre-existing silent global-search fallback that leaked cross-department knowledge (verified fix).
next_action: Keep global search available only for authenticated admin diagnostics, never for anonymous users.
